readInputs: FORM Unslop SKILL.md and relevant signal/repair references

summary.finding: The default-size festival identity and schedule work coherently, with functioning filters, saving, useful recovery and an honest day-pass demo. Remaining material issues concern enlarged-text reflow. A small optional dialog-heading cleanup remains under U19.
summary.mostImportant: Fix the enlarged 900px time/artist overlap before cosmetic subtraction.
summary.preservation: The original wave artwork, plain room filters, actual saved count, bookmark action, schedule dividers, supplied copy, and demo limitations all have concrete roles and should remain.

readingPath.desktop: Festival name and sound artwork establish the event; the adjacent information strip supplies date, hours and venue, followed by a chronological comparison schedule. Programme navigation can bring the schedule into view.
readingPath.mobile: The identity becomes a compact poster followed by date/venue and a stacked schedule. Times, artists, formats, rooms and Save remain visible in each event. Programme and My programme scroll to the schedule.
readingPath.subjectSpecificity: Original concentric waves and a static sound-bar brand mark connect the visual identity to experimental sound without pretending to visualize measured data. The six real supplied programme entries carry the main task.

originalSignals.observation: No decorative pill labels. Room filters and Programme/My programme are plain text buttons with selected underlines. The saved count reflects the actual selected events.
originalSignals.reason: Keep real selection and count feedback; these are working controls.

originalSignals.observation: No italic accents in headings, schedule, dialog, footer, or the SVG artwork. Rendered type is upright.
The page uses available Arial/Helvetica sans stacks and Arial Black for the display wordmark. No Instrument Serif or external fonts.
originalSignals.reason: The system font choices respect the brief and have distinct display/schedule roles.

originalSignals.observation: The hero explicitly uses normal letter spacing. No negative tracking in the source or SVG. Dense display weight is not itself a kerning violation.
originalSignals.reason: Preserve the bold wordmark. Its enlarged-text/artwork interference is a layout issue, reported separately.

originalSignals.observation: The schedule consists of the six supplied events and functional Save controls. No fake analytics, sponsors, testimonials, social counts, or payment steps. The day-pass dialog states checkout is unavailable.
originalSignals.reason: Keep the actual times, artists, set descriptions, rooms, saved count, and local-demo boundary.

originalSignals.observation: Rules separate chronological event rows; underlines show active views and room filters. No rules between every text fragment or nested panel stack.
originalSignals.reason: These rules support comparison and selected state. Removing them would weaken schedule scanning.

originalSignals.observation: A small flat paper/ink/red palette uses a quiet text color, row-rule color, demo-notice surface, and dark modal backdrop. Artwork is opaque. No arbitrary ladder of faded decorative labels.
originalSignals.reason: The distinctions have semantic roles. No shade/opacity correction established by this audit.

originalSignals.observation: Event content is unboxed. Borders identify Save and Close buttons and the day-pass action. The dialog is a separate interaction surface rather than a decorative nested card system.
originalSignals.reason: Keep the boundaries of interactive controls and the modal.

originalSignals.observation: The SVG contains concentric ellipses and straight interruptions, without labels, measurements, invented connections, or technical claims. It functions as a festival graphic, not a data diagram.
originalSignals.reason: Keep the sound-related original artwork. Avoid reclassifying its repeated geometry as fake technical detail.

originalSignals.observation: The introduction, date/time, venue, schedule, saved-state guidance, and checkout limitation each supply useful information. The dialog heading repeats the one-day/three-room idea already in the introduction; its smaller copy improvement is grouped with U19.
originalSignals.reason: Preserve supplied copy and practical recovery/demo information. Consolidate the optional dialog headline if correcting R04.

originalSignals.observation: No file paths, fake code, version strings, or implementation labels decorate the visitor interface. Browser-storage and local-demo wording explains behavior that visitors need to understand.
originalSignals.reason: Keep truthful storage and checkout limitations.

originalSignals.observation: No decorative 01/02 section numbers. Times order the real schedule and the numeric saved count reflects selections.
originalSignals.reason: The numbers are functional content, not ceremonial numbering.

originalSignals.observation: No repeated label-heading scaffolding. The header descriptor identifies the festival type and Room labels the actual filter group.
originalSignals.reason: Keep distinct orientation and control labels; neither repeats its adjacent heading.

originalSignals.observation: No ASCII or terminal-like scenery. Original artwork is geometric SVG.
No doodled underlines, loose annotation marks, or squiggled arrows. The concentric wave artwork and four-bar brand mark visibly relate to sound and form the requested graphic identity.
originalSignals.reason: Keep the subject-specific motif. Correct its enlarged-text positioning under R03 rather than deleting expressive artwork.

originalSignals.observation: No monospace costume. Schedule times and the saved count use tabular numerals within the sans interface stack.
originalSignals.reason: Keep tabular figures for scanning; they do not require a font change.

originalSignals.observation: Labels and supporting copy use sentence/title case; no repeated uppercase subtitle system. The SVG has no text.
Hero, page, footer, dialog, and SVG use flat colors. No ambient gradients or haze.

Buttons, filters, navigation, and main programme headings have no ornamental periods. The dialog title “One day. Three rooms.” is an added punctuated fragment that repeats the introduction; “Day pass” would identify the current task more directly. The supplied tagline and full-sentence empty/recovery/demo copy legitimately retain punctuation.
originalSignals.reason: R04 is a small copy consistency recommendation, not a blanket punctuation ban. Preserve supplied facts and actual sentences.

additionalDefaults.observation: No tiny colored status/demo/availability dots in visible states, SVG artwork, or pseudo-elements. The monochrome four-bar brand mark is static sound imagery, with no live-status implication.
additionalDefaults.reason: Keep the brand mark; it is not an activity light.

additionalDefaults.observation: No arrow glyphs, chevrons, or drawn arrows on Programme, room filters, Save, day-pass, Close, recovery, footer, or artwork. The bookmark is a conventional Save symbol and not a directional arrow.
additionalDefaults.reason: Keep meaningful bookmark feedback and plain action labels.

unresolvedIssues.observation: With computed font sizes doubled at 900×1000, all six time labels overlap the adjacent artist names. Time glyphs extend from x=36 to x=156.125 while artist glyphs start at x=134, producing 22.125px horizontal overlap. The default-size 900px view did not show this collision.
unresolvedIssues.consequence: Users enlarging text cannot reliably separate when a set begins from its artist. This is a task failure even though the events are present in the DOM.
unresolvedIssues.recommendation: Make the time track content-sized or reflow the time above the artist when enlarged content no longer fits. Use intrinsic widths or relative-unit breakpoints rather than retaining the fixed 80px time column. Recheck the same six rows at 900px with enlarged text.
unresolvedIssues.confidence: observed in render and text glyph bounds

unresolvedIssues.observation: At doubled text, the 900px day-pass header button extends to x=916.156, 16.156px beyond the viewport. In the 390px day-pass modal, dialog clientWidth is 320px but scrollWidth is 327px, and the Close button extends beyond the dialog’s right edge. Normal-size desktop/mobile controls worked.
unresolvedIssues.consequence: The header action and modal Close boundary are clipped horizontally for enlarged-text users. The modal can scroll vertically as expected, but it should not require horizontal recovery to expose a control boundary.
unresolvedIssues.recommendation: Allow the header groups and dialog title/Close group to wrap based on content. Give the title a shrinkable track or put Close on its own row at constrained sizes. Preserve the native dialog and all ticket facts.
unresolvedIssues.confidence: observed in render and element bounds

unresolvedIssues.observation: At doubled text the wordmark wraps into “Sig” and “nal”, while the absolutely positioned wave art still starts from the original clamp-based title offset. Art begins at x=292.5, y=403.594 and intersects the right side of the enlarged wordmark, whose box runs x=20–370 and y=306–680.406. The black-on-black intersection merges part of the lettering with the pattern. The default mobile wordmark remains readable.
unresolvedIssues.consequence: The festival identity loses clarity specifically under enlarged text; deleting the graphic would unnecessarily remove the requested expressive identity.
unresolvedIssues.recommendation: Reserve a separate flow/grid area for the artwork, or reposition it using the actual text region so it cannot occupy enlarged wordmark glyphs. Keep the concentric sound motif.

unresolvedIssues.category: U19 copy consistency / U10 repeated framing
unresolvedIssues.observation: The added title “One day. Three rooms.” repeats the introductory promise and uses punctuated fragments for a short task heading. It also occupies multiple lines in the mobile dialog.
unresolvedIssues.consequence: It adds framing where the visitor primarily needs day-pass information; this is a smaller consistency opportunity than the real enlargement failures.
unresolvedIssues.recommendation: Use “Day pass” as the dialog heading, retain £28 and all exact date/time/location facts, and preserve punctuation in the supplied tagline and complete explanatory sentences. Do not use the copy change as a substitute for fixing R02’s layout.
unresolvedIssues.confidence: editorial judgment based on task role, not a universal prohibition on periods

enlargedText.method: Doubled each element’s computed font size in the transient browser DOM; no source edits. This is text-enlargement stress, not actual browser zoom or a full accessibility audit.

artworkAndPseudoElements.svgContent: 19 concentric ellipse strokes, a clipping frame, and straight color interruptions; no text, icons, dots, arrows, gradients, or external references.
artworkAndPseudoElements.computedBeforeAfterContent: No non-empty ::before/::after generated content in inspected page/modal state. ::backdrop is the legitimate modal scrim.

limits: No comparison with prior/current/revised cases, handoffs, or evaluation documents. This was an explicit cross-review, not a blinded benchmark.
Chromium only; no physical devices, screen-reader session, full WCAG audit, or actual browser zoom.
Storage success/reload was exercised; blocked-storage fallback was inspected in source but not force-tested.
Screenshots are local audit evidence in a temporary directory.
No numerical taste, AI-authorship or beauty score was assigned.
publicationNote: Substantive observations retained; local paths normalized. Audit findings concern the preserved pre-repair snapshot; repair verification concerns the corrected example.
